configuration.indexing: Clause/tile/variable indices are zero-based; signed literals are +/-1..4; integer bit j is variable x_(j+1).
configuration.ties: Choose the smallest variable index among minimum-energy neighbors; identical across methods.
configuration.phase: First trap uses updateIndex r=0; phase=2*pi*r/phi^2.

tiling.role: Clause j uses rotation of tile j. Reflections are recorded but do not change the update rule. Geometry neither adds clauses nor certifies SAT.

methods.uniform: Strict descent; stop on a non-solution trap.
methods.breakout: At a trap add 1 to each currently violated clause weight.
methods.orientation_cos: At a trap add 1+0.5*cos(theta_j-2*pi*r/phi^2) to violated clause j only.
methods.orientation_341: At a trap add .25+g(theta_j-2*pi*r/phi^2) to violated clause j only, with g(a)=3+4*cos(a)+cos(2*a)=2*(1+cos(a))^2; compute the squared form.

interpretation: Two deliberately selected tiny examples, not a performance benchmark. Each method uses different boost magnitudes. Energy decreases only between weight updates; total energy need not decrease across updates. All positive weights preserve exactly the SAT zero set.
tests: Exact SAT zero sets checked for all16 assignments at every recorded event.
All flips change exactly one bit and strictly decrease the current fixed weighted energy.
Every boost changes only violated clause weights, with strictly positive increments.
All reported final success states satisfy every original clause.
